workFolder.description: Folder for job worktrees. A relative value is resolved by the Runner against the person's home folder (os.homedir()); never a hard-coded drive.

studioOrigin.description: The one origin the local media server answers with CORS.

oneOf.description: Per item producers for the generate stage, with an optional `default`.

contentRepoUrl.description: Git remote the Runner clones for job worktrees (the content repo). Any git URL or a local path.

intake.description: Source intake adapters, chosen by name. Never chosen by operating system.

renderer.description: Page renderer adapter: pdfjs (default), pdftoppm, or api:<provider> later.

imageDpi.description: Resolution of the JPEG working copies a session reads.

mediaStore.description: Where page images are kept: local-disk now, a remote store later.

engine.description: OCR adapter: wasm (default, bundled), native, auto, or api:<provider> later.

tessdataFolder.description: Folder with extra traineddata files for other source languages.

batchPages.description: Override of the template batch size (scan pages per session).

sessionTimeoutMinutes.description: How long one Claude session may run, in minutes, before the Runner stops it. Leave out for 30 minutes. The STUDIO_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MS environment value, when set, wins over this.

claudeCommand.description: Full path (or command name) of Claude Code on this machine. The stable choice: a copy inside a VS Code extension folder changes folder with every extension version. Leave out to look in STUDIO_CLAUDE_BIN, PATH and the usual install folders. `studio-runner doctor` checks it.

maxParallelSessions.description: Most simultaneous Claude sessions on this machine.

pauseOnLimit.description: Pause and resume when the person's Claude usage limit is reached.

loadLimit.description: No new work is claimed while the one-minute load per core is above this.
